scope: Targeted primary-report and discrepancy audit; not clinical review or systematic publication-status clearance.

checks.locator: pp 48–51, Tables 1–2, Fig 1 and Results; image inspected pp 48–50
checks.population: 69 healthy women 35–55, Fitzpatrick I–IV, self-reported dry forearms; pregnancy and breastfeeding excluded
checks.adverse_events: No discomfort or adverse reactions reported; exact event ascertainment denominators not provided; product tolerance checked during study.
checks.commercial_support: GELITA provided branded VERISOL product; cash funding and full sponsor role not established from inspected text.

outcomes.p: <0.05 for both arms at both time points
outcomes.dispersion: SEM in figure; no exact arm means or arm-specific SD extracted
outcomes.note: not absolute risk or percentage-point stretch mark reduction

checks.limitations: Shared placebo; subgroup sample small; figure caption n≥9 conflicts with 5 g age-50-plus table n=8; per-visit missingness handling unclear; no pregnancy, abdominal skin, striae or multiyear prevention endpoint. Do not infer individual benefit or use a dose recommendation.

checks.locator: Grimes/Mahto Table 1 and reference 11; Proksch Table 1 and Subjects, Fig 1
checks.finding: The reanalysis says the cited Proksch trial did not compare collagen to placebo; the exact cited primary study explicitly randomized 23 to maltodextrin and reports placebo-relative comparisons. It may lack recoverable separate arm endpoint means or variance; that is different from no placebo comparison. Reason for exclusion requires author clarification and supplementary code review.
checks.status: unresolved discrepancy; no allegation of misconduct or retraction; do not invalidate the entire reanalysis or reinclude trial automatically

checks.finding: Technical critique targets the 2021 de Miranda and 2023 Pu reviews, not the 2025 funding-stratified or July 2026 updated review. Dose slopes are not the same estimand as pooled treatment effects. Reports SEM/SD mix-ups, modality mixing and extracted sample issues. Reanalysis is also subject to verification, including PA-002.
checks.chart_rule: Do not plot dose coefficient alongside treatment SMD as interchangeable; interval level to verify from model output.

checks.funding: Authors declare no conflicts; cash funding not established from abstract; primary funding not thereby established.
checks.limitations: No direct pregnancy outcomes; review overlap likely; structural wrinkle, density and roughness findings unstable in sensitivity analyses. Full PMC access blocked; primary extraction remains incomplete.

checks.locator: Cochrane summary/indexed review; broader review abstracts; HUMBA protocol serious adverse event definitions
checks.finding: Protocol serious events include maternal/infant death and ICU admission plus other serious events referred to independent monitoring. This does not establish complete adverse-event reporting in final paper. Cochrane identifies ongoing/unpublished studies; this does not establish receipt of unpublished PE events. No change to existing PE denominators.
checks.status: open; no new pooled estimate; distinguish serious adverse event collection from preeclampsia adjudication

publication_status.scope: Targeted title/PMID and correction/retraction keyword searches for S015 and CL02 plus accessible article metadata for S012. No correction/retraction notice located in inspected results; S015 and 2025 review PubMed direct opens blocked, no Crossmark or Retraction Watch database-wide verification. Not cleared.

next: Obtain supplementary code for CL02, re-evaluate inclusion of S015 and exact covariance/arm data; resolve HUMBA PE endpoint and Lindsay registry; perform systematic DOI status checks and independent clinical review.
